description: This file contains unit tests for key-value type classes in the WPEFramework Core library, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: KeyValueType
classes.description: A template class representing a key-value pair with comparison and accessor methods.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: A class representing a fragment of text, possibly used as a key in key-value pairs.

classes.name: TextKeyValueType
classes.description: A template class for key-value pair where key and value are of type TextFragment, parameterized by case sensitivity.

methods.name: Key()
methods.description: Returns the key component of KeyValueType.

methods.name: Value()
methods.description: Returns the value component of KeyValueType.

methods.name: IsKey()
methods.description: Checks if the key matches a given string.
